 Order

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.340/2023, registered at Police Station - Gadhasarai, District Dindori (M.P.)
for commission of offence punishable under Sections 363, 376(2)(n) of IPC, section 3, 4, 5L/6 of POCSO Act and Section 3(1)(w)(ii), 3(2)(v) of SC/ST Act.
Applicant is in detention since 19.02.2023.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not sexually assaulted the prosecutrix.
He has been falsely implicated.
She was the consenting party.
She herself went with the applicant.
In her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, she has not stated anything against the applicant.
Applicant has no criminal record.
Charge sheet has been filed.
Trial of the case will take time.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.
4 . O n the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: Having taken into consideration the above submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties, but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which applicants may be released on bail.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicants, stands allowed.

6 . It is directed that applicants be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) each with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that they shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

They shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7 .
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
